scenes.title: How the Water Cycle Works
scenes.subtitle: From ocean to cloud to rain, step by step
scenes.text: Where does rain come from? Let's follow a single drop of water on its journey around the planet.

scenes.title: Evaporation
bullets: Warm vapour rises into the sky
scenes.text: It starts with the sun. Its heat warms oceans and lakes, turning water into invisible vapour that rises into the sky.

scenes.title: Condensation
bullets: Billions of droplets form a cloud
scenes.text: As the air climbs higher, it cools. The vapour condenses into tiny droplets, and billions of them gather to form a cloud.

scenes.title: Precipitation
bullets: They fall as rain, snow or hail
Rivers carry water back to the sea
scenes.text: When the droplets merge and grow too heavy, they fall as rain, snow or hail. Rivers then carry the water back to the sea.

scenes.title: And the cycle repeats
scenes.text: Evaporation. Condensation. Precipitation. And then, the cycle begins again.
